PATIENT INFORMATION

When you need answers, we’re here.

Book an appointment Choose a clinic, date and time online. Have your referral handy. View my images Use the secure SMS link we send after your scan, on any device. Find a clinic Roxburgh Park, Deer Park and Bacchus Marsh. Walk-ins welcome.

Your visit, step by step

  1. 1 BookOnline, by phone, or walk in. Prep instructions are sent with your booking.
  2. 2 Have your scanBring your referral and Medicare card. Our radiologist reports your images.
  3. 3 View images & see your doctorWe send your report to your doctor and an SMS link to your images. [CONFIRM TIMING]

HOSPITAL PATHWAYS

Embolisation procedures, through our public hospital partners.

We see you in clinic, complete your imaging and work-up, then refer you directly to an interventional radiology team at a public hospital — and stay in touch with your doctor throughout. [CONFIRM HOSPITAL PARTNERS]

Ask about a pathway
  • Uterine artery embolisationFibroids and adenomyosis
  • Prostate artery embolisationEnlarged prostate (BPH)
  • Ovarian vein embolisationPelvic venous congestion
  • Varicocele embolisationScrotal varicose veins

    From your GP or specialist
  2. 2 · Consultation
    Meet your interventional radiologist
  3. 3 · Procedure
    In our clinic, or at a partner hospital
  4. 4 · Follow-up
    Review, and a letter to your doctor

Screening enquiry

Tell us a little about you. We’ll call with the details and the cost.

A few minutes of questions helps our team match you to the right scan and check it’s safe for you. There’s nothing to pay online. Screening is privately funded, so a team member will phone you to talk through your answers, tell you the full fee and find a time.

  1. 1Scan
  2. 2About you
  3. 3Your health
  4. 4Safety
  5. 5Referral

What would you like to know more about?

Choose as many as you like. You don’t need to be sure. “Not sure” is a good answer.

About you

So we know who we’re calling and which clinic suits you.

Sex at birth Helps us choose the right questions and protocols

Your health

Answer what you can. “Not sure” is fine, and we’ll go through it together on the call.

Brain aneurysm / AVM MRI
In the past few days, have you had a sudden, severe headache, a seizure or blackout, or new weakness, numbness, speech or vision changes?
Please don’t wait for an enquiry. These can be signs of an emergency. Call 000 or go to your nearest emergency department now. Screening is for people without symptoms.
Has a parent, brother, sister or child ever had a brain aneurysm or a bleed around the brain (subarachnoid haemorrhage)?
How many close relatives?
Have you been told you have any of these? Tick all that apply
Do you smoke?
Have you had a brain scan before? CT or MRI
Women’s health check
What would you like us to look into? Tick all that apply
Has a close relative had breast or ovarian cancer?
Have you noticed a new breast lump, nipple discharge, or bleeding after menopause?
Please see your GP soon. New symptoms like these should be checked promptly. You can still send this enquiry, and we’ll explain what a referral needs to include.
Heart, lung, vascular & abdominal
Do you smoke?
Have you been told you have any of these? Tick all that apply
Did a parent or sibling have a heart attack, stroke or aneurysm before age 60?
No problem. Tell us what’s on your mind in the last step, and a team member will talk through the options with you on the phone.

A quick safety check

These help our radiographers keep you safe. Answer as best you can. We’ll confirm everything with you before your scan.

MRI safety
Do you have any of these? Tick all that apply
Do you find small or enclosed spaces difficult?
Would you find it hard to lie flat and still for a while?
For every scan
Are you pregnant, or is there a chance you could be?
Do you have kidney disease?
Have you ever had an allergic reaction to contrast dye (the injection used in some scans)?

Referral & anything else

This helps us advise you on the phone. We don’t ask for any payment details here.

Do you have a referral from a doctor for this scan?
That’s okay. We’ll explain on the call whether a referral is needed for your scan and how to get one.
About cost. Screening scans aren’t covered by Medicare, so the full fee is paid by you. We’ll phone you with the exact cost before anything is booked.

Please check the highlighted questions.

Thanks. We’ve got your enquiry.

    OUR DOCTORS

    Meet the experts
    behind your care.

    Our radiologists are the heart of inOne Imaging — fellowship-trained specialists dedicated to accurate diagnosis and compassionate, patient-centred care.

    From CT and ultrasound to interventional radiology and women’s imaging, our team brings world-class expertise to Roxburgh Park, Deer Park and Bacchus Marsh.

    Our radiologists

    GM

    Dr Goran Mitreski

    Diagnostic & Interventional Radiologist

    Dr Goran is an Interventional & Diagnostic Radiologist with subspecialty expertise in advanced image-guided intervention, hepatobiliary imaging, neuroradiology and thoracic imaging.

    • Interventional Radiology
    • Hepatobiliary Imaging
    • Neuroradiology
    • Cardiac CT
    • Image-Guided Interventions
    Publications →
    DL

    Dr Daniel Liu

    Diagnostic & Procedural Radiologist

    Dr Liu is a consultant radiologist with subspecialty expertise in neuroradiology, breast imaging and procedures, and obstetric and gynaecological imaging.

    • Neuroradiology
    • Breast Imaging
    • Obstetric & Gynaecological Imaging
    • Image-Guided Interventions
    JM

    Associate Professor Julian Maingard

    Diagnostic & Interventional Neuroradiologist

    A/Prof Maingard is a specialist Diagnostic Neuroradiologist, Interventional Radiologist and Neurointerventional Radiologist, bringing tertiary-level expertise in advanced diagnostic imaging, minimally invasive image-guided interventions and complex neurovascular procedures to inOne Imaging Bacchus Marsh.

    • Neuroradiology
    • Interventional Radiology
    • Neurointervention
    • Image-Guided Interventions
    • Emergency Imaging
    Publications →
    KC

    Dr Kevin Chen

    Diagnostic & Procedural Radiologist

    Dr Kevin Chen is a specialist radiologist with fellowship training in oncology imaging, abdominal imaging, and general MRI. He is a FRANZCR-accredited CT colonography reporter with a special interest in image-guided interventional procedures.

    • Oncology Imaging
    • Abdominal Imaging
    • General MRI
    • CT Colonography
    • Image-Guided Interventions
    TK

    Associate Professor Terry Kok

    Diagnostic & Interventional Radiologist

    A/Prof Terry Kok is a Diagnostic and Interventional Radiologist with subspecialty expertise in Interventional Radiology, Cardiac (CT, MRI), Thoracic, Neuro and Abdominal Imaging. He is Director of Imaging Services at Northern Health.

    • Interventional Radiology
    • Cardiac Imaging (CT, MRI)
    • Thoracic Imaging
    • Neuroradiology
    • Abdominal Imaging

    HOW WE PRACTISE

    Our approach to care

    1. 01Patient-first careOur doctors take the time to explain every scan and put patients at ease from the moment they arrive.
    2. 02Clinical excellenceFellowship-trained radiologists delivering accurate, timely reports across all major imaging modalities.
    3. 03Latest technologyReading from state-of-the-art CT, ultrasound, X-ray and DEXA equipment for the highest diagnostic accuracy.
    4. 04Bulk-billed accessCommitted to making expert imaging affordable and accessible for Medicare patients across Melbourne.

    OUR STORY

    Expert imaging,
    close to home.

    inOne Imaging was founded by Dr Mohammed Alebrahimi with a clear purpose: to bring world-class diagnostic imaging to Melbourne’s growing communities.

    MEET THE FOUNDER

    Dr Mohammed Alebrahimi

    Prime Minister’s Medicare Excellence Award finalistRecognised for excellence in healthcare and passion for patients and community.

    Dr Mohammed Alebrahimi is the founder and driving force behind inOne Imaging. With a clinical background spanning allied health and diagnostic services, he identified a critical gap in Melbourne’s outer suburbs — communities underserved by quality, affordable imaging — and built inOne Imaging to fill it.

    Recognised at the Prime Minister’s Medicare Awards for demonstrating excellence in healthcare and passion for patients and community. Under his leadership, inOne Imaging has established state-of-the-art clinics across Melbourne, delivering bulk-billed CT, ultrasound, X-ray, DEXA and interventional radiology with fast turnaround and compassionate care.

    Get in touch →
    WHAT WE STAND FOR

    Our core values

    1. 01Patient-centred imagingEvery scan, every report, every interaction is designed around the patient — compassionate care from booking to results.
    2. 02Diagnostic excellenceOur radiologists deliver accurate, timely reports across all major modalities, backed by the latest imaging technology.
    3. 03Advanced technologyInvesting in state-of-the-art CT, ultrasound, X-ray and DEXA equipment to ensure the highest diagnostic accuracy.
    4. 04Community accessBringing bulk-billed, expert imaging to Melbourne’s outer suburbs — where it’s needed most.
    OUR JOURNEY

    Key milestones

    1. 2019Founded inOne HealthcareStarted with a vision to make diagnostic imaging and allied health accessible to all Australians, regardless of location or circumstance.
    2. 2023inOne Imaging establishedLaunched inOne Imaging to bring expert diagnostic services — CT, ultrasound, X-ray and more — directly to Melbourne communities.
    3. 2024Medicare Excellence Award finalistRecognised at the Prime Minister’s Medicare Awards for excellence in healthcare and passion for patients and community.
    4. 2025Three Melbourne clinics and growingNow operating at Roxburgh Park, Deer Park and Bacchus Marsh — with a full suite of imaging modalities and further expansion underway.

    Whether you’re a patient needing an appointment, a GP looking to refer, or a professional wanting to join our imaging team — we’d love to hear from you.
